caption: Figure 5. Two-dimensional vector mode locking. (a,b) Integer windings m and n over the 91 sampled rocking-amplitude/period points at theta=1.5 deg; the map includes pinned (0,0) as well as transporting integer-winding states. (c) The tau*=40 slice shows the sampled vector staircase. (d) Independent DOP853 and Radau monodromy calculations agree on the extremely small leading Floquet spectral radius and relative-periodic closure of the representative (1,-1) orbit; this is local attraction evidence rather than a claim of global uniqueness.
